title: 伯纳姆接受国王邀请组建政府 成英国十年内第六位首相
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I have just come from booking in palace where I have accepted his Majesty the King's invitation to form a government.
segments.zh: 我刚从王宫出来，接受了国王陛下的邀请组建政府。

segments.en: In doing so, I am acutely conscious that I am the sixth person in the last ten years to walk up this street,
segments.zh: 我深知，我是过去十年中第六位走上这条街的人。
自2016年以来的第七位首相。

segments.en: Making this a moment for reflection and new resolution.
segments.zh: 这让我们反思并确立新的决心。

segments.en: It requires my generation of politicians to raise our game and rise to the new challenge.
segments.zh: 我们这一代政治家需要提升自己，迎接新挑战。

segments.en: Britain needs to show the world that we can regain our stability once again
segments.zh: 英国需要向世界展示我们能重获稳定。

segments.en: and that is our challenge to make politics work, to make it work better.
segments.zh: 我们的挑战是让政治发挥作用，并且更好地发挥作用。
